questions.stem: When silver plating a steel spoon, what should be used as the electrolyte?
questions.explanation: The electrolyte must contain ions of the plating metal. Since the spoon is being silver plated, the electrolyte must contain silver ions, so silver nitrate solution (AgNO₃) is used. The silver ions in solution are attracted to the cathode (the spoon) where they deposit as a thin silver coating.
